c4.desc: 4 cores, 2x2 mesh, 1 home slice and 1 outlet per core (assumed scaling of the 3-core shell)

c6.desc: 6 cores, 3x2 mesh, 1 home slice and 1 outlet per core

c6o3.desc: 6 cores, 3x2 mesh, 6 home slices, outlets stay 3 (HBM side unchanged)

c8.desc: 8 cores, 4x2 mesh, 1 home slice and 1 outlet per core

clk150.desc: 150 MHz; HBM round trip and the 8 fitted outlet cycles fixed in ns; RTL pipeline depths fixed in cycles (timing closes)

clk150p.desc: 150 MHz as above, plus assumed extra pipeline registers on on-chip paths (x1+(r-1)/2)

clk200.desc: 200 MHz; HBM round trip and the 8 fitted outlet cycles fixed in ns; RTL pipeline depths fixed in cycles (timing closes)

clk200p.desc: 200 MHz as above, plus assumed extra pipeline registers on on-chip paths (x1+(r-1)/2)

clk250.desc: 250 MHz; HBM round trip and the 8 fitted outlet cycles fixed in ns; RTL pipeline depths fixed in cycles (timing closes)

clk250p.desc: 250 MHz as above, plus assumed extra pipeline registers on on-chip paths (x1+(r-1)/2)

o6.desc: 6 HBM outlets for 3 cores (2 per core)

lat_half.desc: HBM round trip halved (23->12) and outlet return 13->9: what a faster memory path would give

lane2.desc: two NoC/home lanes (home engine and links duplicated)

port2.desc: two core memory ports (LSU and tensor engine each get a port; tnca_mem_mux.v has one)

memideal.desc: ceiling of all memory-side levers: zero-latency NoC, home, outlet and HBM (1 cycle each), 32 outlets, 8 lanes, 128 MSHR

lsuf4.desc: hybrid LSU: line-path landing slots 8->4 (cheaper LSU)

sfu2.desc: SFU_LANES=2 (rtl/core/tnca_sfu.v: VLEN/LANES passes + LAT 6): occupancy 14, latency 15

sfu4.desc: SFU_LANES=4 (rtl/core/tnca_sfu.v: VLEN/LANES passes + LAT 6): occupancy 10, latency 11

sfu16.desc: SFU_LANES=16 (rtl/core/tnca_sfu.v: VLEN/LANES passes + LAT 6): occupancy 7, latency 8

vi1.desc: single-cycle issue of vector-datapath instructions (the base model uses 2; mechanism in the RTL not identified: operand fetch width is the candidate)

vrf0.desc: no VRF bank conflicts (ideal register-file read ports)

le0.desc: line engine, RTL eligibility rule (tnca_tensor.v le_elig)

le2.desc: LINE_HALF: half-line (32 B) rows eligible (dma_line_elig=2; RTL in R42-lineelig)

g4.desc: K-fusion group G=4 (timing only; equivalent to a 2x wider lane array for engine busy time)

g8.desc: K-fusion group G=8 (timing only; equivalent to a 4x wider lane array for engine busy time)

mpf.desc: MTX_PIPE: next step B register read under the current sweep

s1.desc: scalar/branch instructions of matrix K loops free (hardware loop + hoisting upper bound)

s2.desc: every instruction of matrix K loops free of the issue slot (macro-command upper bound)

hl.desc: hardware loop: scalar/branch of EVERY innermost loop free and taken branch free (upper bound)

dual.desc: 2-wide issue, upper bound: scalar/branch/special/predicate instructions never take the issue slot

br0.desc: zero-cost taken branch and context switch

pf4.desc: home-slice next-line prefetch: a read miss also fetches the next 3 lines (existing model key tl_prefetch_lines=4)

sets64.desc: NUCA slice 64 sets x 8 ways x 64 B = 32 KiB per slice (was 16 KiB)

sets128.desc: NUCA slice 128 sets x 8 ways x 64 B = 64 KiB per slice (was 16 KiB)

sets512.desc: NUCA slice 512 sets x 8 ways x 64 B = 256 KiB per slice (was 16 KiB)

k1.desc: 6 cores, 3x2 mesh, 1 home slice and 1 outlet per core | 200 MHz; HBM round trip and the 8 fitted outlet cycles fixed in ns; RTL pipeline depths fixed in cycles (timing closes)

k2.desc: 6 cores, 3x2 mesh, 1 home slice and 1 outlet per core | 200 MHz; HBM round trip and the 8 fitted outlet cycles fixed in ns; RTL pipeline depths fixed in cycles (timing closes) | single-cycle issue of vector-datapath instructions (the base model uses 2; mechanism in the RTL not identified: operand fetch width is the candidate)
